method: Full reading of all four revised English essays against all four revised Chinese essays. The existing English literary structure is retained, not a block-for-block retranslation. Checked argument, factual corrections, attribution and natural prose.

findings.issue: Garden letter sender and recipient reversed.
findings.resolution: Source editor corrected Chinese, Hant and English: Qian Zhongshu handed his fragmentary letters to Yang Jiang. Final JSON rechecked.

preserved_arguments: Non-instrumental domestic life and absence of an exchange ledger
Memoir proportions and private memory without denying historical suffering
Home constituted by people rather than ownership
Survivor preserves the completed shared life
limits: Literary interpretations remain interpretations. Independent chronological verification beyond the source audit is not claimed. No assertion of identical paragraph structure or comprehensive printed-edition collation.
post_review_source_clarification: Re-read Chinese article 3 block 2 after saved-braid modifier clarification. English and German already mean the preserved braid belonging to the daughter, not necessarily preserved by her. No target change required; target hash unchanged.
